title: Add reusable Positive Vision agent
summary: Added a Positive Vision agent spec that turns make-it-happen pressure into grounded optimism, agency, pathways, if-then plans, risk truth, and fallback options.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked Hope Theory, implementation intentions, goal-setting theory, and psychological safety references.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.notes: Ran memory bootstrap and reused platform governance anchors.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.notes: Selected governance mode and agent-platform ownership.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.notes: Added REQ-WS-065, specs, source provenance, and plan evidence.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Added agent config, docs, and history artifacts.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Run agent inspection/list/orchestration, unit tests, memory/config/docs checks, workspace maps, task board, workspace health, and monitor collect/test/check/build.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Run omission, grounding, and work evaluator checks; write evaluation reports.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.notes: Commit and push are performed as the final close-out step after evaluation.

bottleneck_notes: Governance artifacts and bilingual documentation dominate this agent-only change.
The agent reuses existing planning, grounding, omission, and timing tools instead of creating a new runtime.
improvement_candidates: Create an agent-spec scaffold for reusable domain agents after a few more similar agents stabilize the pattern.
